name: Alternative Fuel Stations in New York
description:
Go to https://afdc.energy.gov/stations/#/find/nearest to access the full database of alternative fuel station locations nationwide, collected and maintained by the U.S. Department of Energy National Renewable Energy Laboratory.  A station appears as one point in the data and on the map, regardless of the number of fuel dispensers or charging outlets at that location.  For EV charging stations for example, the data includes the number of number of charging ports available at the specific station.

The New York State Energy Research and Development Authority (NYSERDA) offers objective information and analysis, innovative programs, technical expertise, and support to help New Yorkers increase energy efficiency, save money, use renewable energy, and reduce reliance on fossil fuels. To learn more about NYSERDA’s programs, visit https://nyserda.ny.gov or follow us on X, Facebook, YouTube, or Instagram.

columns.name: Fuel Type Code
columns.description:
BD = Biodiesel (B20 and above); CNG = Compressed Natural Gas; E85 = Ethanol (E85); ELEC = Electric; HY = Hydrogen; LNG = 
Liquefied Natural Gas; LPG = Liquefied Petroleum Gas (Propane)

columns.name: Station Name
columns.description: The name of the station

columns.name: Street Address
columns.description: The street address of the station's location

columns.name: Intersection Directions
columns.description: Brief additional information about how to locate the station

columns.name: City
columns.description: The city of the station's location

columns.name: State
columns.description: The two character U.S. state code of the station's location

columns.name: ZIP
columns.description: The ZIP code (postal code) of the station's location

columns.name: Plus4
columns.description: The plus-4 portion of the station's ZIP code (U.S. ZIP codes only)

columns.name: Station Phone
columns.description: The phone number of the station

columns.name: Status Code
columns.description: The current status of the station - E = Open

columns.name: Expected Date
columns.description: For planned stations, the date the station is expected to open or start carrying alternative fuel. For temporarily unavailable stations, the expected date is the date the station is expected to reopen. This date is estimated but not guaranteed

columns.name: Groups With Access Code
columns.description:
A description of who is allowed to access the station and other station access information.
Public = Publicly available to all customers; Public – call ahead = Publicly available, but customers should call before visiting the station. See “Station Phone” for more details; Public – credit card at all times = Publicly available, but only accepts credit cards as payment. The station may also accept fleet cards or station-specific fueling cards. See “Cards Accepted” field for more details; Public – card key at all times = Publicly available, but only accepts fleet cards or station-specific fueling cards as payment. See “Cards Accepted” field for more details; Public – credit card after hours = Publicly available, and accepts credit cards 24 hours a day. See “Access Days Time” and “Cards Accepted” fields for more details; Public – card key after hours = Publicly available, and accepts fleet cards or station-specific fueling cards 24 hours a day. See “Access Days Time” and “Cards Accepted” fields for more details

columns.name: Access Days Time
columns.description: Hours of operation for the station

columns.name: Cards Accepted
columns.description: A space-separated list of payment methods accepted - for explanation see http://developer.nrel.gov/docs/transportation/alt-fuel-stations-v1/all/#fuel-station-record-fields.

columns.name: BD Blends
columns.description: For biodiesel stations, the level of biodiesel blends the station provides

columns.name: NG Fill Type Code
columns.description:
For CNG stations, the type of dispensing capability available.
Q = Quick fill; T = 
Timed fill; B = Both: quick fill and timed fill

columns.name: NG PSI
columns.description: For CNG stations, a space separated list of PSI pressures available

columns.name: EV Level1 EVSE Num
columns.description: For electric stations, the number of Level 1 EVSE (standard 110V outlet)

columns.name: EV Level2 EVSE Num
columns.description: For electric stations, the number of Level 2 EVSE (J1772 connector)

columns.name: EV DC Fast Count
columns.description: For electric stations, the number of DC Fast Chargers

columns.name: EV Other Info
columns.description: For electric stations, the number and type of additional EVSE, such as: SP Inductive = Small paddle inductive; LP Inductive = Large paddle inductive; Avcon = Conductive

columns.name: EV Network
columns.description: For electric stations, the name of the EVSE network, if applicable

columns.name: EV Network Web
columns.description: For electric stations, the EVSE network Web site, if applicable

columns.name: Geocode Status
columns.description:
A rating indicating the approximate accuracy of the latitude and longitude for the station's address.
GPS = The location is from a real GPS readout at the station; 200-9 = Premise (building name, property name, shopping center, etc.) level accuracy; 200-8 = Address level accuracy; 200-7 = Intersection level accuracy; 200-6 = Street level accuracy; 200-5 = ZIP code (postal code) level accuracy; 200-4 = Town (city, village) level accuracy; 200-3 = Sub-region (county, municipality, etc.) level accuracy; 200-2
Region (state, province, prefecture, etc.) level accuracy; 200-1 = Country level accuracy; 200-0 = Unknown accuracy

columns.name: Latitude
columns.description: The latitude of the station's address (see the "Geocode Status" field for details on the latitude's accuracy)

columns.name: Longitude
columns.description: The longitude of the station's address (see the "Geocode Status" field for details on the longitude's accuracy)

columns.name: Date Last Confirmed
columns.description: The date the station's details were last confirmed

columns.name: ID
columns.description: A unique identifier for this specific station

columns.name: Updated At
columns.description: The time the station's details were last updated  (ISO 8601 format)

columns.name: Owner Type Code
columns.description:
The type of organization that owns the fueling infrastructure
P = Privately owned; T = Utility owned; FG = Federal government owned; LG = Local government owned; SG
State government owned; J = Jointly owned (combination of owner types)

columns.name: Federal Agency ID
columns.description: If owned by a federal agency, a unique identifier for the federal agency

columns.name: Federal Agency Name
columns.description: If owned by a federal agency, the name of the federal agency

columns.name: Open Date
columns.description: The date that the station began offering the fuel. Please note that LPG (propane) stations do not have open dates. Some open dates are approximate

columns.name: Hydrogen Status Link
columns.description: For hydrogen stations, a link to a website that provides up-to-date information about the current status of this hydrogen station

columns.name: NG Vehicle Class
columns.description:
For CNG and LNG stations, the maximum vehicle size that can physically access the fueling infrastructure.
LD = Station can only accommodate light-duty vehicles (Classes 1-2); MD = Station can accommodate light- and medium-duty vehicles (Classes 1-5); HD = Station can accommodate light-, medium-, and heavy-duty vehicles (Classes 1-8)

columns.name: LPG Primary
columns.description:
For propane stations, the type of station.
true = Primary: A propane station is considered primary because it meets the following criteria, developed based on feedback from the propane industry: 1.The price of a gallon of propane autogas, including all taxes, at the station is less expensive than other propane sold (e.g., gas grill bottles);
2.The station is able to fuel vehicles during normal business hours (e.g., 8am-5pm M-F); and
3.The station accepts credit cards. false = Secondary: The station does not meet the criteria to be considered primary

columns.name: E85 Blender Pump
columns.description:
For E85 stations, an indication of whether the station has a blender pump on site.
true = In addition to E85, the station has a blender pump capable of providing mid-level ethanol blends. false = The station does not have a blender pump

columns.name: EV Connector Types
columns.description:
For electric stations, an array of strings identifying the connector types available at this station.
NEMA515 = NEMA 5-15 (Level 1); NEMA520 = NEMA 5-20 (Level 1); NEMA1450 = NEMA 14-50 (Level 1); J1772 = J1772 (Level 2); CHADEMO = HAdeMO (DC fast charging); J1772COMBO = SAE J1772 Combo (DC fast charging); TESLA = Tesla (DC fast charging)

columns.name: Country
columns.description: The country of the station’s location

columns.name: Intersection Directions (French)
columns.description: Brief additional information about how to locate the station, in French, if available.

columns.name: Access Days Time (French)
columns.description: Hours of operation for the station, in French, if available.

columns.name: BD Blends (French)
columns.description: For biodiesel stations, the level of biodiesel blends the station provides, in French, if available.

columns.name: Groups With Access Code (French)
columns.description: A description of who is allowed to access the station and other station access information, in French, if available: Privé: Private station; Privé - réservé aux clients de parcs: Private station that may allow other entities to fuel through a business-to-business arrangement. For more information, fleet customers should refer to the “Access Days Time” field for contact information or contact the station directly; Privé – réservé au gouvernement: Private station available only to government vehicles, or some subset of government vehicles; Public: Publicly available to all customers; Public – appeler à l'avance: Publicly available, but customers should call before visiting the station. See “Station Phone” for more details; Public – carte de crédit en tout temps: Publicly available, but only accepts credit cards as payment. The station may also accept fleet cards or station-specific fueling cards. See “Cards Accepted” field for more details; Public – carte-clé en tout temps: Publicly available, but only accepts fleet cards or station-specific fueling cards as payment. See “Cards Accepted” field for more details; Public – carte de crédit après les heures d'ouverture; Publicly available, and accepts credit cards 24 hours a day. See “Access Days Time” and “Cards Accepted” fields for more details; Public – carte-clé après les heures d'ouverture: Publicly available, and accepts fleet cards or station-specific fueling cards 24 hours a day. See “Access Days Time” and “Cards Accepted” fields for more details; PRÉVU - pas encore accessible: Not yet open, but plans to carry alternative fuel in the future. See the "Expected Date" field for an anticipated open date; TEMPORAIREMENT SUSPENDU: Temporarily unavailable. See the “Expected Date” field for an anticipated open date.

columns.name: Hydrogen is Retail
columns.description: For hydrogen stations, whether a station offers the retail sale of hydrogen by accepting payment at the point of sale, given as code values as described below: true: Station meets the criteria to be considered retail; false: Station does not meet the criteria to be considered retail.

columns.name: Access Code
columns.description: A description of who is allowed to access the station, given as code values as described below: public: Publicly available to all customers; private: Private station.

columns.name: Access Detail Code
columns.description: A description of other station access information, given as code values as described below: KEY_ALWAYS: Card key at all times; CREDIT_CARD_ALWAYS: Credit card at all times; CREDIT_CARD_AFTER_HOURS: Credit card after hours; FLEET: Fleet customers only; GOVERNMENT: Government only; KEY_AFTER_HOURS: Card key after hours; CALL: Call ahead.

columns.name: Federal Agency Code
columns.description: If the station is owned by a federal agency, a record for the federal agency that owns this station. See federal agency record fields for response details.

columns.name: Facility Type
columns.description: The type of facility at which the station is located, given as code values as described below: AIRPORT: Airport; ARENA: Arena; AUTO_REPAIR: Auto repair shop; BANK: Bank; BREWERY_DISTILLERY_WINERY: Brewery/distillery/winery; B_AND_B: B&B; CAMPGROUND: Campground; CARWASH: Carwash; CAR_DEALER: Car dealer; COLLEGE_CAMPUS: College campus; CONVENIENCE_STORE: Convenience store; CONVENTION_CENTER: Convention center; COOP: Co-op; FACTORY: Factory; FED_GOV: Federal government; FIRE_STATION: Fire station; FLEET_GARAGE: Fleet garage; FUEL_RESELLER: Fuel reseller; GAS_STATION: Service/gas station; GROCERY: Grocery store; HARDWARE_STORE: Hardware store; HOSPITAL: Hospital; HOTEL: Hotel; INN: Inn; LIBRARY: Library; MIL_BASE: Military base; MOTOR_POOL: Motor pool; MULTI_UNIT_DWELLING: Multi-Unit dwelling; MUNI_GOV: Municipal Government; MUSEUM: Museum; NATL_PARK: National park; OFFICE_BLDG: Office building; OTHER: Other; OTHER_ENTERTAINMENT: Other entertainment; PARK: Park; PARKING_GARAGE: Parking garage; PARKING_LOT: Parking lot; PAY_GARAGE: Pay-parking garage; PAY_LOT: Pay-parking lot; PHARMACY: Pharmacy; PLACE_OF_WORSHIP: Place of worship; PRISON: Prison; REC_SPORTS_FACILITY: Recreational sports facility; REFINERY: Refinery; RENTAL_CAR_RETURN: Rental car return; RESEARCH_FACILITY: Research facility/laboratory; RESTAURANT: Restaurant; REST_STOP: Rest stop; RV_PARK: RV Park; SCHOOL: School; SHOPPING_CENTER: Shopping center; SHOPPING_MALL: Shopping mall; STADIUM: Stadium; STANDALONE_STATION: Stand-alone station; STATE_GOV: State/provincial government; STORAGE: Storage facility; TRAVEL_CENTER: Travel center; TRUCK_STOP: Truck stop; UTILITY: Utility.

columns.name: CNG Dispenser Num
columns.description: For CNG stations, the number of CNG dispensers installed.

columns.name: CNG On-Site Renewable Source
columns.description: For CNG stations, the type of renewable energy used to generate CNG on-site, given as code values as described below: GEOTHERMAL: Geothermal; HYDRO: Hydropower; LANDFILL: Landfill; LIVESTOCK: Livestock Operations; SOLAR: Solar; WASTEWATER: Wastewater Treatment; WIND: Wind.

columns.name: CNG Total Compression Capacity
columns.description: For CNG stations, the total compressor capacity per compressor, measured in standard cubic feet per minute (scfm).

columns.name: CNG Storage Capacity
columns.description: For CNG stations, the total storage capacity, measured in standard cubic feet (scf).

columns.name: LNG On-Site Renewable Source
columns.description: For LNG stations, the type of renewable energy used to generate CNG on-site, given as code values as described below: GEOTHERMAL: Geothermal; HYDRO: Hydropower; LANDFILL: Landfill; LIVESTOCK: Livestock Operations; SOLAR: Solar; WASTEWATER: Wastewater Treatment; WIND: Wind.

columns.name: E85 Other Ethanol Blends
columns.description: For E85 stations, an array of strings identifying the range(s) of blends other than E85 available at the station, given as code values described below: E15: Station also offers E15; E20-E25: Station also offers blends of E20-E25; E30-E35: Station also offers blends of E30-E35; E40-Plus: Station also offers blends of E40 and above.

columns.name: EV Pricing
columns.description: For EVSE stations, information about whether and how much users must pay to use the EVSE.

columns.name: EV Pricing (French)
columns.description: French language description: For EVSE stations, information about whether and how much users must pay to use the EVSE.

columns.name: LPG Nozzle Types
columns.description: For LPG stations, an array of strings, identifying the type of nozzles available at the station, given as code values described below: ACME: ACME; QUICK_CONNECT: Quick-connect

columns.name: Hydrogen Pressures
columns.description: For hydrogen stations, any array of strings identifying the pressures of the hydrogen available (in bar), given as code values as described below: 350: 350 bar (35 megapascal, or MPa); 700: 700 bar (70 MPa).

columns.name: Hydrogen Standards
columns.description: For hydrogen stations, any array of strings identifying which SAE International fueling protocol standard(s) the infrastructure meets, given as code values as described below: J2601: SAE J2601; J2601-2: SAE J2601-2.

columns.name: CNG Fill Type Code
columns.description: For CNG stations, the type of dispensing capability available, given as code values as described below: Q: Quick fill; T: Timed fill; B: Both: quick fill and timed fill.

columns.name: CNG PSI
columns.description: For CNG stations, a space separated list of PSI pressures available.

columns.name: CNG Vehicle Class
columns.description: For CNG stations, the maximum vehicle size that can physically access the fueling infrastructure, given as code values as described below: LD: Station can only accommodate light-duty vehicles (Classes 1-2); MD: Station can accommodate light- and medium-duty vehicles (Classes 1-5); HD: Station can accommodate light-, medium-, and heavy-duty vehicles (Classes 1-8). Note: This field does not take into account station capacity or other considerations.

columns.name: LNG Vehicle Class
columns.description: For LNG stations, the maximum vehicle size that can physically access the fueling infrastructure, given as code values as described below: LD: Station can only accommodate light-duty vehicles (Classes 1-2); MD: Station can accommodate light- and medium-duty vehicles (Classes 1-5); HD: Station can accommodate light-, medium-, and heavy-duty vehicles (Classes 1-8). Note: This field does not take into account station capacity or other considerations.

columns.name: EV On-Site Renewable Source
columns.description: For EVSE stations, the type of renewable energy used to generate electricity on-site, given as code values: GEOTHERMAL: Geothermal; HYDRO: Hydropower; LANDFILL: Landfill; LIVESTOCK: Livestock Operations; SOLAR: Solar; WASTEWATER: Wastewater Treatment; WIND: Wind.

columns.name: Georeference
columns.description: Open Data/Socrata-generated geocoding information from supplied address components.

columns.name: Restricted Access
columns.description: For public stations, an indication of whether the station has restricted access, given as a boolean:

columns.name: RD Blends
columns.description: For renewable diesel stations, the level of renewable diesel blends the station provides.

columns.name: RD Blends (French)
columns.description: For renewable diesel stations, the level of renewable diesel blends the station provides, in French, if available.

columns.name: RD Blended with Biodiesel
columns.description: For renewable diesel stations, whether the station provides renewable diesel blended with biodiesel, given as code values as described below: Y - Yes; N - No.

columns.name: RD Maximum Biodiesel Level
columns.description: For renewable diesel stations, the maximum biodiesel level if blended with biodiesel.

columns.name: NPS Unit Name
columns.description: Which national park the unit is in

columns.name: CNG Station Sells Renewable Natural Gas
columns.description: Whether the station sells renewable natural gas (RNG)

columns.name: LNG Station Sells Renewable Natural Gas
columns.description: Whether the station sells renewable natural gas (RNG)

columns.name: Maximum Vehicle Class
columns.description: The maximum vehicle size that can physically access the fueling infrastructure

columns.name: EV Workplace Charging
columns.description: Whether the station is available for employees at a workplace

columns.name: Funding Sources
columns.description: List of funding sources used to build the EV charging unit

columns.name: NYS Municipal Boundaries 2
columns.description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'NYS Municipal Boundaries' (yamh-8v7k) the point in column 'georeference' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.

columns.name: New York Zip Codes 2
columns.description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'New York Zip Codes' (wbg7-3whc) the point in column 'georeference' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.

columns.name: Counties 2
columns.description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'Counties' (kjdx-g34t) the point in column 'georeference' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.
